rationale: The supplied fixed-side change adds a maximum-block-size validation and error return. The Logic section does not mention any block-size bound, rejection of oversized frames, or related mitigation. Its general discussion of decoder state, buffered data, decoding, and returning processed bytes is either represented by the vulnerable loop or is too general to encode the supplied fix. Although the statement about logging and nullifying the frame pointer does not precisely match the shown vulnerable fragment (which nullifies `ptr`), that inaccuracy does not specifically describe the fixed-only behavior.
